Files under gin, ripgrep, mastodon, defectdojo, hyper-app, nodegoat, koel, poetry, webgoat, eshop, vite, serde-json,
sinatra and httpx are copies (some lock files cut to their first entries) of manifests of well-known open-source
projects, kept under those projects' licenses: gin-gonic/gin (MIT), BurntSushi/ripgrep (MIT/Unlicense),
mastodon/mastodon (AGPL-3.0), DefectDojo/django-DefectDojo (BSD-3-Clause), vercel/hyper (MIT), OWASP/NodeGoat
(Apache-2.0), koel/koel (MIT), python-poetry/poetry (MIT), WebGoat/WebGoat (GPL-2.0), dotnet-architecture/eShopOnWeb
(MIT), vitejs/vite (MIT), serde-rs/json (MIT/Apache-2.0), sinatra/sinatra (MIT), encode/httpx (BSD-3-Clause).
The other directories are small hand-written files.
